description.narrative: The project will assist the Government of Assam in strengthening its skills education and training system to ensure decent employment for all and accelerate sustainable and inclusive infrastructure and industrial development. It will create pathways for skills progression and mobility between technical and vocational education and training (TVET) and higher education through the establishment of a skill university, and will raise skill levels to enhance the productivity and competitiveness of industries in Assam. The project will enhance skills and employability of youth and adults, especially women and those from disadvantaged groups, and improve their prospect of getting higher-paying, decent jobs. The project will form part of the strategic engagement of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) with the Government of Assam for economic corridor development, environmental sustainability, and climate change.

Status of Implementation Progress: Since May 2023, ASU Management and Operating System Development Consultants have been supporting the establishment of ASU management and operating systems. The recruitment processes of management, academic and non-academic staff started in August 2023.-Works related to deliverables of CS03 which pertain to University management and operating systems, business models, and faculty development and management systems is under progress. Around 20% of delivery is completed and rests are under progress at various stages.-Bid Evaluation of Business Development support agency has been completed and submission 2 is shared with ADB on 20th Jan'24 for obtaining no objection. -Civil works for interim campus is under progress and is expected to be completed by May'24. Course curriculum is complete and works related to lab set up of ASUs Interim Campus is under progress.- Bid document for Digital Campus platform has been prepared and is under review by a committee formed by ASU; it is expected that report from the committee will be received on or before 31st Mar'24.-ASU started interviewing candidates for 22 faculty and non-faculty staff members posts in late December 2023. Till now 5 faculties, 8 Junior and Senior instructors, 1 Deputy Registrar and 1 Accountant have joined ASU. Appointment letter for the post of Deputy Controller of Examination has been issued and the incumbent is expected to join latest by 31st Mar'24. Recruitment process for the posts of 3 Professors, 1 System Administrator, 1 Asst. Librarian and 1 Administrative officer is under progress and likely to be completed by 31st May'24.Construction of ASU campus, facilities, and the boundary wall has started. Registration for the Indian Green Building Councils assessment process for green campus and building rating is complete and implementation of guideline is under progress. Since May 2023, ASU Management and Operating System Development Consultants have been supporting the establishment of ASU's various organizational units, including the office of industry engagement and commercial ventures. Further progress to be assessed during subsequent review missions.-Partnership opportunities with internationally renowned institutions and industry/employers are being explored. -Activities to commence in July 2024 from the interim campus and in June 2026 from the main campus.
